description: This source file implements the PTMCoreMLFeatureProvider class, which manages feature values for CoreML models in an Objective-C++ environment. It handles setting input tensors, converting them to MLFeatureValues, and providing access to feature values by name.

classes.name: PTMCoreMLFeatureProvider
classes.description: A class that provides feature values for CoreML models, managing a dictionary of feature names and corresponding MLFeatureValues.

methods.name: initWithFeatureNames:
methods.description: Initializes the feature provider with a set of feature names.

methods.name: setInputTensor:forFeatureName:
methods.description: Sets an input tensor for a specific feature name, converting it into an MLFeatureValue.

methods.name: featureValueForName:
methods.description: Retrieves the feature value associated with a given feature name.
